name: STW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands fourteen times before a triple-unified champion carried it, the Unified Double Crown, and the World Light-Heavyweight title together into STW's own closure.

name: STW Supreme/World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Known first as the Supreme Tag Team title, renamed World Tag Team during a later reign; changed hands some sixteen times before its own last champions.

name: STW National Television Championship
epitaph: Changed hands six times before its own last champion was stripped for holding two World Heavyweight titles at once, the belt then unifying with the vacant International title.

name: STW International Title
epitaph: Changed hands five times before its own last champion was stripped for failing to defend it and attacking officials, the belt then unifying with the vacant National Television title.

name: STW Unified Double Crown Title
epitaph: Formed by unifying the vacant International and National Television titles in Bulletin #35; changed hands some fourteen times before its own last champion unified it with two other titles at once.

name: STW Sheer Hardcore Title
epitaph: Changed hands some thirteen times before its own last, official reign.

name: STW World Light-Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Retired once, reactivated once, and changed hands some fourteen times before its own last champion unified it with two other titles at once.

name: STW Intercontinental Women's Title
epitaph: Awarded at its creation, then changed hands some three times before its own last attested champion.

name: STW World Light-Heavyweight Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Attested for two reigns before the surviving record breaks off.

name: STW United States Championship
epitaph: Attested for a single reign before the surviving record breaks off.
